title: Inventory and configuration as the basis of any defence

videos.script: Every lesson in this course protected our machines. Which ones, exactly? {{list}} This is the lesson the others rest on. A control protects the machines somebody remembered, and nothing else. {{sweep}} You will ask the network what is there. Seven machines answer. The firm's list has five. {{collect}} Then one short script asks every machine what it runs, and keeps the answers. {{drift}} A second one compares that with what each machine should be, and puts a name beside every difference. {{loop}} Measure, compare, fix, and measure again. It is the first lesson's habit, for every machine at once.
